shortBackstory: Gateborn Colossus is a non-playable Gateborn Creature whose origin makes The First Reopening visible as living battlefield danger.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Gateborn Colossus grew around unstable Gate stone as a defensive catastrophe. It is not a faction citizen and should never read like a recruitable Titan. Its existence proves that the Gate crisis produces consequences, predators, remnants, and catastrophes beyond civilized armies.

chapters.title: Lore Function
chapters.text: As a Gateborn Creature from Unstable Gate, Gateborn carries a specific warning into the story: A giant malformed guardian grown around unstable Gate stone. It is not a Titan and has no civilization; it is a defensive catastrophe. This makes the creature useful as canon pressure, not random enemy dressing.

chapters.title: Battlefield Behavior
chapters.text: On the map, Gateborn supports its lore through behavior: Controls central objectives and forces Titans to split pressure. Its abilities — Gate Stomp, Fracture Roar, Objective Crush — should feel like the environment and story acting through a threat body.

chapters.title: Campaign Tie
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Gateborn connects to the unstable Gate proving it can grow guardians instead of summoning soldiers. Encounter designers can place it where the player needs to feel what the Gate has damaged: memory, structure, instinct, oath, water, stone, or command.

chapters.title: Visual / Reading Rule
chapters.text: The creature page must preserve the distinction between Titans, NPCs, and non-playable threats. Gateborn can be studied under Creatures and Backstories, but its profile should reinforce danger, not companionship.

developmentStatus: Readable creature profile integrated into dashboard threat pages.
